name: Elihaba
title: One of David's Mighty Warriors
summary: Elihaba was one of King David's brave warriors, known as one of the Thirty Heroes. He came from Shaalbon (also called a Shaalbonite) and served faithfully in David's army. He is mentioned in the lists of David's mighty men in both 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among David's Thirty Heroes
keyEvents.description: Elihaba the Shaalbonite is listed among David's thirty mighty warriors who distinguished themselves in service to the king.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Chronicle of Heroes
keyEvents.description: Elihaba is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles' parallel list of David's brave men, confirming his place among the recognized warriors.

keyEvents.title: Service Under King David
keyEvents.description: As one of the Thirty Heroes, Elihaba served in David's military elite, a group of warriors known for their bravery and loyalty throughout David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's Military Organization
keyEvents.description: David's mighty men, including Elihaba, formed the core of the military leadership that helped David establish and maintain his kingdom over Israel.
